Name: EQUIP_MTRL_SET_PARAM_ST
Description: Material costs: up to six items with amounts. Used for weapon upgrades (the weapon's Reinforcement Material Set ID + the ReinforceParamWeapon offset of the level), goods upgrades such as Spirit Ashes (EquipParamGoods Upgrade Material Set ID) and shop or crafting trades (ShopLineupParam Required Material ID). A slot counts only when its ID is set, its category isn't 15 and its amount is above 0.
